title: TEXTSTYLE DWG encoder allocation rollback and retry
scope: Generated local TEXTSTYLE direct-codec transaction control across legacy inline, detached, separate, and aliased stream layouts

implementation.behavior: Stage the body, detached font/name strings, and handle destination while preserving revision-specific flags, height/width/oblique fields, primary and big-font text, common handles, and the typed legacy-null writer route. Publish only after all staged streams succeed; public and typed writer routes share the implementation.

control.profile: Locally generated TEXTSTYLE with two reactors, extension dictionary, nondefault height/width/oblique/generation flags, primary font, big font, and xref block handle.
control.failure_assertions: Every reached one-shot allocation failure leaves caller body, strings, handles, cursors, health, and handle-occurrence ledgers unchanged. The same object and buffers then retry to clean output.

validation.result: The allocation control reports all seven layouts passing rollback/retry across 182 offsets. All three focused CTests passed.

limits: Generated local transaction evidence only; it does not expand the DWG TEXTSTYLE schema or producer/version qualification.
The typed legacy-null writer route shares the staged implementation but was not separately fault-injected in this receipt.
Native font resolution, rendering, whole-document graph closure, and broad interoperability remain outside this evidence.
